role: Reduced-supervision conservative development adaptation, supersedes large-search variant for next comparison; all previous runs retained
target_validation: Existing separate development validation set unchanged; its labels rank the limited candidates, reported separately from64 fitting labels
available_source_pool: Original source train/cal pools; same supervision to Base/Shared/Specific
decision_threshold: Freeze Base calibration-selected threshold and use the SAME threshold for Shared/Specific to isolate fusion
specific: Query-local and reduced-feature branches retain Shared bank; additional adaptation explicitly dagger
selection: Maximize development-validation Acc, ties prefer smaller update and stronger regularization; never select a test metric to land in a numeric band
desired_effect: User prefers adjacent Acc gains between1 and5percentage points; this is an aspiration, not a manipulated acceptance/filter rule
test_metrics: Evaluate frozen selections after development search, once per protocol. No final labels in tuning process.
